description: Remakes a clip with the user's subject. Read `get_recipe` `reshot` first. CONSENT: a real person's picture only with their permission, never a public figure or celebrity. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), never timers or background shells. No card? Give the user the `url`. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions).

model.description: Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

resolution.description: REQUIRED: use `720p` unless the user asked for `1080p`, and name the choice in the priced ask; never carried over from an earlier request.

source_video.description: The clip, 4-30 s. A URL from this account's generations or uploads, or a public https URL (imported first); another account's is refused.

name: reshot_video
title: Reshot: swap who is in a clip, or transfer its moves
